cluster_label: adult olfactory receptor neuron acid-sensing, Ir75a/b/c, Ir64a
working_definition: Acid-sensing IR ORN cluster with Ir75a, Ir75b, Ir75c (coeloconic) and Ir64a (sacculus) neurons (Li et al. 2022 FCA, Manual Annotation).
searches_performed: adult olfactory receptor neuron acid-sensing, Ir75a/b/c, Ir64a

best_match.fbbt_definition: Odorant receptor neuron (ORN) whose dendrite transduces signals from an antennal sensillum. The axons of these neurons fasciculate in the antennal nerve and innervate the antennal lobe.

justification: Grouped call mixing coeloconic ORNs (Ir75a FBbt:00110013, Ir75b FBbt:00110016, Ir75c FBbt:00051495; parent antennal ORN of coeloconic sensillum) and sacculus-grooved-sensillum ORNs (Ir64a FBbt:00110019). No sensillum-type parent covers both; OLS ancestors confirm adult antennal olfactory receptor neuron is the most specific olfactory common ancestor.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Bilateral ORN expressing Ir64a and Ir8a, sacculus grooved sensillum.
